name: Viator (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally by a white stripe from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green below and light blue above, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Viator (a tree and a bridge on yellow).
history: The flag was approved by decree of the Consejería de Administración Local y Relaciones Institucionales of the Junta de Andalucía in 2014, described as a rectangular flag of 25 by 15 units with green and blue fields arranged obliquely in two quarters.
